data.name: Gorgeous Ghost
data.detailed_description:
Gorgeous Ghost — Nie Xiaoqian VR Trilogy · Episode 1: “Gorgeous Ghost: Fate”

Enter the fantastical world of Pu Songling’s “Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio,” inspired by the classic Hong Kong film “A Chinese Ghost Story.” In this immersive VR interactive graphic novel, you are no longer a spectator. You will step into the Lanruo Temple and become a witness to the poignant beginning of a legendary love between a human and a ghost.

【Key Features】

Live the Classic Beginning: Become a traveler who crosses into the boundary between the mortal world and the netherworld at Lanruo Temple. Encounter the lonely spirit named Nie Xiaoqian and experience the initial moments of fascination and awe.

Immersive VR Graphic Novel: Step into living, dynamic paintings. Every scene—from the moonlit lakeside pavilion to the shadowy corridors—unfolds around you in 360 degrees, recreating the cinematic Eastern aesthetic.

Free Exploration & Interaction: The story progresses automatically, but you can pause at any time. Wander freely within the scene, examine environmental details up close—from gnarled vines to flickering candlelight—and control your level of immersion.

~30 Minute Narrative: Focus on a complete and emotionally rich prologue.

Seamless Experience: Feel free to exit at any point. The game auto-saves your progress. Return later to resume exactly where the story paused, with the atmosphere intact.

【Synopsis】

“Intoxicated, I forget the way home.” Before the warmth of the mortal world fades, the chilly mist of the netherworld begins to entwine. In this forgotten Lanruo Temple, a fateful encounter is about to unfold. Will you feel fear, curiosity, or an inexplicable flutter of the heart? As the line between human and ghost blurs under the moonlight, a destiny that transcends life and death awaits your first step...

data.short_description: A VR comic adapting the ghostly romance of Nie Xiaoqian. Explore the moonlit, fully-realized 3D Lanruo Temple. The tale unfolds via exquisite hand-drawn 2D art. Pause time to investigate still scenes and uncover secrets. Witness an eternal, poetic love between worlds. (First of a trilogy, ~30 mins)
